item.title: New York Classics You Shouldn’t Miss: Broadway, Central Park, Bridges & More
item.description: New York is one of those cities you think you already know, until you’re actually there. From the chaos of Times Square to the magic of Broadway, peaceful walks in Central Park, iconic bridges, and seeing the Statue of Liberty for the first time, this is my honest take on New York’s must-see classics. What’s worth the hype, what’s overrated, and what I’d do differently if I went again.

item.title: 7 Days in New York City: Our First-Time Itinerary (What We Loved & What We’d Skip)
item.description: New York in winter is loud, magical, exhausting, and unforgettable. We spent 7 full days exploring the city for the first time: walking endlessly, chasing Christmas lights, crossing bridges, and learning what actually works (and what doesn’t) when planning a NYC trip. This is our real itinerary, with honest tips, costs, crowds, and everything we wish we knew before going.

item.title: Iconic NYC Bites You Can’t Miss
item.description: New York City is not a place where you simply eat, it’s a place where you plan your days around food. From oversized bagels and pizza slices to classic American diners, street hot dogs, and legendary cookies, this guide covers the NYC food you actually have to try. Based on real experiences (and honest opinions), this post takes you eating your way through New York, one iconic bite at a time.

item.title: Only 3 Museums? These Are the Ones to Visit in New York
item.description: New York City has museums for every kind of traveler — even for those who think museums aren’t really their thing. From the iconic halls of the MET and the creative energy of MoMA to the fun, nostalgic FRIENDS™ Experience, this post covers three New York museums that are truly worth your time. Honest impressions, personal moments, and tips to help you choose the right museum for your NYC trip.

item.title: Extra Time in New York City? Add These to Your List
item.description: New York City can feel like it’s always rushing you, but if you have a little extra time, these are the places that make you slow down and really feel the city. From gliding over the East River on the Roosevelt Island tram to taking in immersive skyline views at Summit, finding calm inside St. Patrick’s Cathedral, and ending the day in Little Italy where it feels more like Europe than New York, this guide is about choosing moments over checklists. Consider this your invitation to experience NYC

item.title: 48 Hours in Washington, DC: Monuments, Museums & Hidden Gems - The Creation of Us
item.description: We took the train from NYC to Washington DC for a 48-hour weekend packed with monuments, museums, chicken & waffles, and hidden cocktail bars. From touring the US Capitol and Library of Congress to walking the National Mall at sunset and ending the night inside a vault at Silver Lyan, here’s exactly how to spend two perfect days in DC — plus practical tips to help you plan your own trip.

item.title: Is Philadelphia Worth Visiting? Here’s My Experience
item.description: Is Philadelphia worth visiting? Here’s my honest 2-day experience — cheesesteaks, Liberty Bell, US Mint tour, NBA game & what I’d skip.

item.title: How to Spend a Layover in Lisbon?
item.description: When booking our flights home, we had two choices: a quick connection or a 22-hour layover in Lisbon. We chose sunshine over sense. After landing from -11 degrees into warm Portuguese air, we turned our stopover into a mini adventure, wandering Bairro Alto, tasting the famous Pastéis de Belém, sipping Portuguese wine, and chasing yellow trams through cobblestone streets. If you’re wondering how to spend a long layover in Lisbon, here’s exactly what to see, eat, and skip (yes, even Pink Street).

item.title: The Perfect Spa Weekend in Rovinj: Grand Park Hotel Rovinj
item.description: A quiet March weekend in Rovinj turned into the ultimate staycation at Grand Park Hotel Rovinj, one of the Top 50 Hotels in the World. From sea-view rooms and a spa surrounded by water and greenery to oysters and champagne at breakfast, here’s why this luxury hotel is perfect for a relaxing off-season escape.

item.title: 3 Days in Malta: What to See, Do & Eat in Just 72 Hours
item.description: Thinking of spending 3 days in Malta? Here’s exactly how we did it: from Golden Bay’s turquoise waters to sunset parties at Café del Mar, slow evenings in Valletta, and hidden gems like Mdina. Plus, honest tips on getting around, where to stay (Sliema is a winner), and how to make the most of your time on this small but surprisingly busy island.
